name: zcode-ops
description: Inspect and control existing ZCode desktop tasks through the official remote workspace bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Read and send to existing ZCode desktop tasks.
interface.longDescription: ZCode Ops reads real desktop task status and existing conversation snapshots, then sends user-authorized prompts through ZCode's remote workspace bridge. Legacy ACP creation remains suspended. The transport is intentionally narrow and can later support other desktop intelligent agents through compatible adapters.
defaultPrompt: 检查 ZCode Ops 的运行状态
列出由 ZCode Ops 保存的会话
